test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Under which ministry in India does NSSO work?

options.text: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Sample Survey Office (NSSO) operates under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI).
 
• The NSSO is responsible for conducting large-scale sample surveys across India to gather socio-economic data.
 
• It was established in 1950, and it plays a crucial role in providing data for planning and policy-making.
 
• MoSPI ensures the coordination of statistical activities in India and maintains statistical standards.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Labour and Employment**

 
 
• This ministry is responsible for protecting and safeguarding the interests of workers in general and the poor, deprived, and disadvantaged sections of society in particular.
 
• It also aims to create a healthy work environment for higher production and productivity.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Commerce and Industry**
 
 
• This ministry formulates and implements policies and programs for achieving growth in the industrial and commercial sectors.
 
• It focuses on trade, exports, and investment promotion.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Planning**
 
 
• This ministry is responsible for the overall planning process in India.
 
• It was merged with the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation in 2019, now functioning under the same umbrella.
